title: Hegel's Philosophy of Mind on the paranormal

tellings.quote: more famous work by Hegel. But Hegel wrote this book philosophy of mind, which is all about, you know, the psyche. And it has extensive passages on the paranormal in it

plain: A philosopher named Jason Jorjani says that Hegel, the German philosopher of the early 1800s, wrote a book called Philosophy of Mind, about the psyche, that has long passages on the paranormal. He draws on the scholar Glenn Alexander Magee, author of Hegel and the Hermetic Tradition, a study of Hegel's ties to old mystical thought. Told this way, it suggests that a pillar of Western philosophy took the paranormal seriously.
